scenario.title: The Long Dark: A New Day in Tessk Crossing
scenario.setting: A galaxy of old trade lanes and older grudges. The Core Worlds are rich and watched, the Outer Rim is lawless and dusty, and the Drift is where ships go to disappear. Hyperlanes join the sectors; a ship and fuel are worth more than most lives.

regions.name: The Core Worlds
regions.lore: Old, rich and policed: the seat of the Concord.

regions.name: The Outer Rim
regions.lore: Desert worlds, smugglers and the law a long way off.

regions.name: The Drift
regions.lore: A scatter of half-charted systems at the edge of the lanes.

regions.name: Aurel
regions.lore: The capital world, one city wide.

regions.name: The Throne Spire
regions.lore: The Concord's seat: guarded, sealed, ceremonial.

regions.name: Vass Prime
regions.lore: Shipyards and the families who own them.

regions.name: Ilion
regions.lore: A garden world gone to seed.

regions.name: Tessk
regions.lore: Two suns, one well, and everyone armed.

regions.name: Morrow
regions.lore: A cold port world where crews sign on.

regions.name: Kade's Reach
regions.lore: A mining belt with one station worth the name.

regions.name: Umber
regions.lore: A dark world under permanent cloud.

regions.name: The Ghost Relay
regions.lore: A dead relay station still broadcasting an old distress call.

regions.name: Engineer workshop and flat.
regions.lore: Engineer workshop and flat. is a small, recently-established droid engineering workshop on the outskirts of Tessk Crossing. It's owned by a newcomer to the city, known only as 'Nox', who is rumored to be highly skilled but keeps to themselves. The workshop is said to be well-equipped, but there are few customers yet, as Nox is still building their reputation in the city.

lore.title: Kesh Varro
lore.text: The Concord admiral who broke the Rim blockade a generation ago; half the Rim still curses the name, the other half drinks to it.

locations.name: Back Room
locations.desc: A cramped workspace filled with tools, half-finished droid parts, and scorch marks on the walls from welding.

locations.name: Shop Floor
locations.desc: A large, open area with a counter at the front, several workbenches, and a droid being worked on in the center.

locations.name: Office
locations.desc: A small, cluttered room with a desk, chair, and a terminal displaying inventory and client information.

locations.name: Apartment
locations.desc: A modest living space with a bed, kitchenette, and a window overlooking the shop below.

locations.name: Front Entrance
locations.desc: A small, covered porch with a sign reading 'Nox Droid Engineering' and a door leading inside.

clocks.name: New Rival
clocks.fireText: A rival engineer opens a shop nearby, undercutting Nox's prices and stealing her clients.

then.name: Reputation Hit
then.fireText: Nox's reputation takes a hit and she struggles to find new clients, risking the shop going under.

extras.name: Tenn Voss
extras.note: Waiting with a delivery of droid parts.

extras.name: Jix
extras.note: Heard shouting drunkenly in the street last night.

extras.name: Lina Nox
extras.note: Zara's estranged sister, recently arrived on Tessk.

extras.name: Kade Karr
extras.note: An up-and-coming engineer trying to impress Zara with his work.

standees.label: Locals
standees.note: A group of regulars stopping by to see what Zara is working on.

standees.label: Rival Droids
standees.note: Droids built by Zara's new rival, left behind after an argument.

facts: Tessk Crossing is a bustling city on the planet Tessk, known for its lawlessness and the constant hustle of its residents.
As a newcomer, you're still trying to establish your reputation as a skilled droid engineer.
Your back room is where you do your most intricate work, away from prying eyes.
scenario.opening: The morning sun creeps through the grimy window of your back room, illuminating the cluttered workspace. The air is thick with the smell of metal and oil. You survey the half-finished droid parts strewn about, trying to recall where you left off the night before. A rusty security droid, Lor Zor, stands sentinel by the door, its optical sensors scanning the room.

regional.text: A dust storm hits Tessk Crossing, cutting power to the workshop and forcing Nox to jury-rig a solution to keep the droids running.
Lek Korr's latest invention goes haywire, causing a commotion in the workshop and drawing unwanted attention from local authorities.

characterData.name: Zara Nox
characterData.want: To build a successful droid engineering business
characterData.description: Zara is a skilled droid engineer, known for her creativity and ability to solve complex problems. She's set up shop in Tessk Crossing, hoping to build a reputation and a steady stream of clients.
characterData.appearance: Zara is a cybernetically-enhanced human, with glowing green eyes and visible metal plating on her left arm and leg. She has short, dark hair and a practical, no-nonsense style of dress.
characterData.voice: She speaks in a calm, measured tone, with a slight mechanical lilt
characterData.secret: She's secretly made a deal with a dangerous crime lord to fund her workshop

characterData.name: Kad Zantos
characterData.want: To track down an old rival and settle a score.
characterData.secret: She's not who she claims to be. She's a wanted criminal on the run from the law.
characterData.voice: She speaks in a low, measured tone, carefully choosing her words.
characterData.appearance: She has a no-nonsense demeanor, with a muscular build and close-cropped hair, and always wears a long coat to hide her many weapons.
characterData.description: A hardened bounty hunter who has spent years tracking down the galaxy's most dangerous criminals, she's not used to asking for help, but she's desperate to find her old rival.
knows: She's seen Nox's droids in action and thinks they're the best she's ever seen, but she's too proud to admit it.

characterData.name: Rella Vax
characterData.want: To be the first to know everything that happens in Tessk Crossing
characterData.secret: She once worked as an information broker for a rival gang, but left after a dangerous job went sour. She keeps her past hidden to avoid attracting unwanted attention.
characterData.voice: She speaks in a rapid, excitable tone, rarely pausing for breath.
characterData.appearance: Short and plump, with a round, rosy face, twinkling eyes, and a perpetual look of excitement. She always wears bright, colorful clothing and has a collection of glittering jewelry.
characterData.description: Rella Vax is the neighborhood gossip and self-appointed 'informer' of Tessk Crossing. She runs a small shop selling trinkets and knick-knacks, but her real business is gathering and selling information.
knows: She's noticed the strange droid parts Nox has been buying and suspects she's working on something big.

characterData.name: Lek Korr
characterData.want: To be recognized as the best mechanic in Tessk Crossing
characterData.secret: She is secretly an inventor, creating prototype droids in her spare time
characterData.voice: She speaks with a warm, enthusiastic tone, always ready to chat about engines or droids
characterData.appearance: Short and muscular, with grease-stained overalls and a tool belt slung low on her hips
characterData.description: Lek Korr is a skilled mechanic with a passion for tinkering. She runs a small garage on the outskirts of Tessk Crossing, specializing in repairing and modifying vehicles and droids
knows: She thinks Nox is a brilliant engineer but worries that her methods are a bit unorthodox.

characterData.name: Lor Zor
characterData.want: To protect the shop, even if it means breaking a few rules
characterData.secret: She was reprogrammed to protect a valuable artifact hidden in the shop, but her memory banks are deteriorating and she can't remember what it is or where it's hidden
characterData.voice: She speaks in a robotic monotone, occasionally stuttering or repeating phrases
characterData.appearance: Her once-polished metal frame is now scratched and dented, with rust forming on her joints. She has a single, glowing red eye that scans the room constantly.
characterData.description: Lor Zor is a malfunctioning security droid left behind by the previous tenant. She patrols the shop floor, occasionally glitching and repeating phrases like 'Intruder detected' or 'System error'. Despite her rusty appearance, she is still a formidable presence, and her programming compels her to protect the shop at all costs.
knows: She's heard rumors that Nox is hiding something valuable in the workshop, but she can't remember what it is.

characterData.name: Jax
characterData.want: To find a way off Tessk and start a new life
characterData.secret: She's been stealing small parts from the workshop to sell for food, but she's running out of options
characterData.voice: Softly, with a hint of a rasp
characterData.appearance: A small, skinny girl with dirty cheeks and a mop of tangled brown hair, wearing tattered clothes that are too big for her
characterData.description: Jax is a young street urchin who's been surviving on her wits and nimble fingers since her parents disappeared. She's drawn to Nox's workshop, hoping to learn enough to get off Tessk and find a better life
knows: She's seen Nox working late into the night and suspects she's trying to perfect a new invention.

[+0m] You turn to face Lor Zor, your cybernetic enhancements whirring softly. "Morning, Lor," you greet her, your voice a calm, measured tone with a slight mechanical lilt.

Lor Zor's optical sensors flicker to life, focusing on you. Her once-polished metal frame is now scratched and dented, with rust forming on her joints. "Greetings, Nox," she responds in her robotic monotone. "How may I assist you today?"

You glance around the cluttered back room, taking in the half-finished droid parts strewn about. "I need to get back to work on that B1 unit. Make sure no one interrupts me, would you?"

Lor Zor nods, her head making a soft clicking sound. "As you wish, Nox. I will ensure your work is not disturbed." She turns back to face the door, her optical sensors scanning the room vigilantly.
